eligibility: Existing approval/lock/answer/shared-pool rules preserved; unknown is held but unavailable

indexes.environment: PGlite in memory, actual metadata distribution; UUID/enum columns represented as text. Plans are local evidence, not production latency.

before.name: 형식별 ID 후보 쪽
before.sql: SELECT id FROM problem WHERE pool='shared' AND actual_format=$1 ORDER BY id LIMIT 12

before.name: 희소 형식 전체 문항 집계
before.sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT COALESCE(question_group_key,'row:'||id)) FROM problem WHERE pool='shared' AND actual_format=$1

before.name: 단원·형식별 코드순 후보 쪽
before.sql: SELECT id FROM problem WHERE pool='shared' AND unit_id=$1 AND actual_format=$2 ORDER BY problem_code,id LIMIT 12

before.name: 단원·형식별 문항 합집합
before.sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT COALESCE(question_group_key,'row:'||id)) FROM problem WHERE pool='shared' AND unit_id=$1 AND actual_format=$2

before.name: 자료·형식별 실제 은행순 후보 쪽
before.sql: SELECT p.id FROM problem p JOIN unit u ON u.id=p.unit_id WHERE p.pool='shared' AND p.source_material_id=$1 AND p.actual_format=$2 ORDER BY p.question_number,u.order_index,p.problem_code LIMIT 12
